plans.problem_statement: The reviewed 인간 phrase became the unnatural noun 人間.
plans.suggested_change: Propose a context-sensitive person-noun check in naturalness guidance.
plans.expected_benefit: Reduce literal lexical substitutions while retaining source meaning.
plans.potential_risk: A strict fidelity or completeness instruction may reduce fluency or encourage unsupported reconstruction.
plans.verification_method: Human review plus a future isolated regression corpus comparison; no result is claimed in this stage.

plans.problem_statement: Reviewed transport and island-access information was omitted.
plans.suggested_change: Propose a clause-coverage checkpoint for explicit scene logistics.
plans.expected_benefit: Make omission evidence visible before accepting a translation.
plans.potential_risk: A strict fidelity or completeness instruction may reduce fluency or encourage unsupported reconstruction.
plans.verification_method: Human review plus a future isolated regression corpus comparison; no result is claimed in this stage.

plans.problem_statement: Anger-induced bedrest was shifted into wailing.

plans.expected_benefit: Reduce action and emotional-state semantic drift.
plans.potential_risk: A strict fidelity or completeness instruction may reduce fluency or encourage unsupported reconstruction.

plans.problem_statement: The concrete loss or shortening of a holiday was weakened.
plans.suggested_change: Propose preserving explicit consequence and degree in fidelity guidance.
plans.expected_benefit: Retain semantic precision without prescribing a final translation.
plans.potential_risk: A broader style or precision instruction may alter acceptable narrative choices.
plans.verification_method: Human review plus a future isolated regression corpus comparison; no result is claimed in this stage.

plans.problem_statement: 一周 conflicts with the reviewed Traditional Chinese style convention.
plans.suggested_change: Propose a non-destructive Traditional Chinese typography consistency check.
plans.expected_benefit: Improve orthographic consistency without changing meaning.
plans.potential_risk: A narrow style instruction may still over-normalize source-period wording.
